notes: Added Pet Tracing automation with automatic board solving, special-tool planning, reward handling, and daily progression.
Redesigned the Automation Hub navigation with grouped Daily, Inventory, and Events sections plus a Dashboard.
Improved Auto Sell outfit enhancement detection, reviewed-stack resolution, and Sell confirmation validation.
Improved Activity Log readability and removed duplicate log entries.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Pet Tracing automation with automatic 3x3 board scanning and route solving.
Added automatic selection of the best starting card for connected arrow sequences.
Added Pet Tracing support for Chain, Rotate/Reposition, and Reveal tools with resource-aware planning and animation/state synchronization.
Added automatic New Card lifecycle handling, Holding reward detection, Into Pack support, and daily progression until Remaining reaches 0.
Added Pet Tracing Start/Stop controls and live automation status.
Added a Dashboard and reorganized the sidebar into Daily, Inventory, and Events sections.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved Auto Sell outfit enhancement detection for +0, +1, and higher enhancement levels.
Improved Auto Sell reviewed-stack resolution before destructive actions.
Improved Auto Sell Sell-confirmation validation while preserving strict quantity, item identity, and bound/unbound checks.
Simplified the Automation Hub interface by removing unnecessary descriptions and helper text.
Improved Activity Log layout, indentation, wrapping, and source formatting.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Auto Sell confirmations when the game omits the enhancement suffix for +0 and enhanced outfits.
Fixed reviewed Auto Sell stacks being incorrectly reported as changed or moved before selling.
Fixed Auto Sell context-menu targeting and confirmation handling for reviewed outfit stacks.
Fixed duplicate Activity Log entries caused by overlapping logging paths.
